subject: Math
content:
THEMA 1
A. Let f be continuous on [a,b]. If G is an antiderivative of f on [a,b], prove that $int_a^b f(t) dt = G(b)-G(a)$. Units 12
B1. Let f(x)=sin x. Prove that f is differentiable on R and f'(x)=cos x. Units 8
B2. Mark True or False.
a. If f is defined on [a,b] and continuous on (a,b], then f has a maximum on [a,b].
b. Every one-to-one function is strictly monotonic.
c. If lim f(x)=0, then lim |f(x)|=0.
d. If f is differentiable, then int f(x) dx = x f(x) - int x f'(x) dx.
e. If lim f(x)>0 then f(x)>0 near x0.

subject: Math
content:
THEMA 2
Let z be a complex number and f(n)=i^n z.
a. Prove f(3)+f(8)+f(13)+f(18)=0.
b. If |z|=r and Arg(z)=t, show f(13)=r(cos(t+pi/2)+i sin(t+pi/2)).
c. If |z|=2 and Arg(z)=pi/3, find the area of the triangle with vertices 0, z, f(13).

subject: Math
content:
THEMA 3
Let f,g be functions on R and suppose f(g(x)) is one-to-one.
a. Prove g is one-to-one.
b. Prove that g(f(x)+x^3-x)=g(f(x)+2x-1) has exactly two positive and one negative solution.

subject: Math
content:
THEMA 4
a. Let h,g be continuous on [a,b]. If h(x)>g(x) for all x, prove int_a^b h(x) dx > int_a^b g(x) dx.
b. Let f be differentiable on R and satisfy e^{f(x)}-f(x)=x+1 and f(0)=0.
(i) Express f'(x) as a function of f(x).
(ii) Prove x/2<f(x)<f'(x) for x>0.
(iii) If E is the area bounded by the graph of f, x=0, x=1 and the x-axis, prove 1/4<E<f(1)/2.

content:
REPEAT THEMA 1
If z1=r1(cos t1+i sin t1) and z2=r2(cos t2+i sin t2), prove z1 z2=r1 r2(cos(t1+t2)+i sin(t1+t2)).

subject: Math
content:
REPEAT THEMA 2
Let f(x)=(e^x-1)/(e^x+1).
a. Prove f is invertible and find f inverse.
b. Prove f inverse(x)=0 has unique solution.
c. Compute int_{-1/2}^{1/2} f inverse(x) dx.

subject: Math
content:
REPEAT THEMA 3
Let f(x)=(x^2+z^2)/(x^2+|z|^2).
a. Compute limits at plus and minus infinity.
b. Find extrema if |z+1|>|z-1|.
c. Find range and number of roots.

subject: Math
content:
REPEAT THEMA 4
Let f satisfy f''(x)f(x)+(f'(x))^2=f(x)f'(x) and f(0)=1.
a. Find f.
b. Show int_x^{2x} g(t)/(1+f(t)^2) dt=1 has unique solution in [0,1].

a. If z1/z2=x+iy find x,y.
b. If z1/z2 is a root of x^2+bx+2c=0 find b,c.
c. Find locus |z-z1|=2|z-z2|.

b. Find asymptotes.
